test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate form of the bracketed verb in the following sentence to fill in the blank. If only we_________ (has) started earlier, we would be there now.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**had**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**had**" is the past perfect tense form of the verb "**have**."
 
• The sentence describes a hypothetical situation in the past, so the past perfect tense "**had**" is required.
 
• **Options 2, 3**, and 4 are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"If only we **had**__ started earlier, we would be there now."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "has been"** is incorrect because it does not fit the hypothetical past situation.
 
• **Option 3: "have been"** is incorrect; the correct form would be "had been" for past perfect tense, but this does not fit the structure of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "have"** is incorrect because it does not fit the hypothetical past situation.

``
